hooks.text: 用模块化零件和预制蓝图逐块搭建自由堡垒
hooks.excerpt: A highly modular building system allows you to design your fortresses exactly as you desire – one piece at a time, with blueprints you have designed in advance, or using community creations shared by other players.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 利用承重结构坍塌同时威胁敌我并制造大规模压杀机会
hooks.excerpt: Keep an eye on structural integrity and load-bearing columns as falling pieces will kill friend and foe alike, often creating unique opportunities to crush numerous enemies with cleverly placed vulnerabilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 白天探索扩建，入夜前布置兵力迎击恐魔浪潮
hooks.excerpt: Spend your days exploring the world and pursuing the growth of your fortress, but as the sun starts to set, you would be wise to position your forces in preparation for the night’s onslaught.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后半段战役因缺少新想法而拖沓。

excerpts.excerpt: the back-half of the campaign drags thanks to a lack of new ideas
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 搭建操作繁琐，视角与卡位耗时。

excerpts.excerpt: 搭房子太累了，转视角和卡位太耗时间
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 雨天屋顶机制会遮挡单位操作视角。

excerpts.excerpt: 加了屋顶以后移动士兵会被挡住视角
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 最优蓝图固定，个性化搭建缺乏实际意义。

excerpts.excerpt: 追求个性的搭建几乎没有意义，因为最优解已经定死了
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 逐砖搭建并保存蓝图的城堡系统自由度高。

excerpts.excerpt: 每一块砖都可以自己搭，也可以保存蓝图快速建造
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 叙事出乎意料地有吸引力。
